subject: Briefing: availability blip affecting hosted API - BridgePoint Analytics
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Desai <amit@bridgepoint.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@bridgepoint.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-02T18:20:00Z
Subject: Briefing: availability blip affecting hosted API - BridgePoint Analytics

Hi Amit / Elena,

I wanted to let you know we observed a short availability blip in our hosted inference API (us-west-1) starting at 18:07 UTC that impacted a subset of requests for BridgePoint Analytics. Symptoms: elevated 502/503 rates and increased p95 latency for prompt sizes >1k tokens.

What we did immediately:
- Routed your traffic to our us-east fallback pool to reduce error rate.
- Rolled a targeted runtime restart for the affected host group.
- Engaged SRE to collect stack traces and error logs.

Current status (18:20 UTC): error rate reduced but still above normal (~2.4% for impacted endpoints). We are continuing mitigation; our current ETA for full recovery is ~30 minutes.

Attachments: short log snippet and a quick SLO-impact brief (attached).

Next steps for us:
- Complete host-level remediation and verify KV cache integrity.
- Monitor your traffic after reroute, and confirm whether you observe any dropped sessions.
- Follow up with a post-incident summary and any credit/SL adjustments.

If you'd prefer, we can move your production traffic entirely to a dedicated pool for the next 24 hours while we finish root cause analysis — happy to coordinate.

Apologies for the disruption. I will send a recovery update as soon as the error rate returns to baseline.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: bridgepoint_incident_log_snippet.txt, slo-impact-brief.pdf

Cc: Elena Morales <elena@bridgepoint.ai>, procurement@bridgepoint.ai
Date: 2027-11-02T18:26:00Z
Subject: Re: Briefing: availability blip affecting hosted API - BridgePoint Analytics

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the quick update. A few questions:

1) Do you have a recommended cutoff for retry logic on our side for now? We've got some client SDKs retrying at 500ms which could be contributing to burst traffic.
2) If we accept a temporary move to dedicated capacity, can we do that without code changes? We need an ETA on how long that would take and any expected costs (we may need procurement involved).

We can also accept a brief call if that's faster.

— Amit
Amit Desai
Head of Platform Engineering, BridgePoint Analytics
amit@bridgepoint.ai

Date: 2027-11-02T18:52:00Z
Subject: Update: availability blip — mitigation in place

Hi Amit / Elena,

A quick update: we completed the targeted restart and activated the us-east fallback routing for your production cluster. Error rate for the affected endpoints has dropped to ~0.6% and p95 latency has improved to within 10% of baseline.

Regarding your questions:
- Retry recommendation: please increase retry backoff to >=1s with jitter to avoid tight retry storms while we finish backend stabilization.
- Dedicated pool: we can provision a temporary dedicated pool without code changes; provisioning + warm-up is approximately 18–36 minutes depending on model size. We'll keep you updated if you want us to proceed.

We're continuing to monitor and will share a short post-incident summary with root cause and remediation items.

Jordan

Subject: Post-incident summary & next steps — BridgePoint Analytics (us-west-1)

Hi Amit / Elena,

Thanks again for your patience. Final update and next steps:

Incident summary:
- Timeline: 18:07–18:48 UTC (partial availability impact).
- Impact: brief elevation in 502/503 and p95 latency for longer prompts; ~8.3% of BridgePoint requests received an error at peak.
- Immediate mitigation: failover to us-east, targeted runtime restart, and circuit-breaking adjustments.

Root cause (initial findings):
- Our preliminary RCA points to a kernel selection path in a small subset of inference hosts that, under a particular long-context request mix, led to degraded scheduling and KV cache thrashing. SRE has captured traces and we are preparing a patch to tighten kernel fallbacks and add additional cache guards.

Customer-facing remediation and offers:
- We have provisioned a temporary dedicated pool for BridgePoint; it is warm and we can route traffic back if you prefer (no code changes).
- As a goodwill gesture we propose a 12-hour service credit for the impacted window; Ben will follow up with formal credit numbers.
- We will schedule a 60-minute postmortem review with your team tomorrow PT; Monica will send the calendar invite.

Attachments: error-rate-timeseries.png, bridgepoint_incident_log_snippet.txt, slo-impact-brief.pdf

Public links: status page incident and internal investigation folder: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2027-11-02-usw1-availability | https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/BRIDGEPOINT-INC-20271102
